verdicts.notes: wow. absolutely incredible. amazing work with this one.one possible next edit i’d like you to draft for me: the smiley face is a sphere, or some shape that has volume like an oblate spheroid. it’s a thing that the creature is holding up to deceive the viewer.

this is so excellent. send a review team that checks for the visual coherence of this model (would it just look like some scattered, dense objects or would it look like a cohesive artistic presentation? we can go back and forth with this question to refine the finer details.) but i really like this base model.
